{"id":"fedistract-rr9g.5","title":"Create fedi-provenance crate: content origin proofs","description":"Minimal content provenance for media attachments — cryptographic proof of who posted what and when. C2PA-lite for the fediverse.

Backwards-compatible: provenance metadata is an optional field on media attachments. Existing servers ignore it. Aware servers can display provenance badges ('Original post by @alice@example.com, unmodified since 2024-01-15').

NOT full C2PA (that spec is 200+ pages and requires embedded metadata in the media file itself). This is a lightweight alternative that works at the AP object level.

Provenance claim structure:
{
  'type': 'ContentProvenance',
  'creator': 'did:key:z6Mk...',           // DID of original poster
  'created': '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z',      // when first posted
  'integrity': 'sha256-base64hash',        // SRI hash of media bytes
  'assertion': 'original',                 // or 'repost', 'edited', 'ai-generated'
  'proof': 'z...'                          // Ed25519 signature over canonical claim
}

Public API:
- create_provenance(media_bytes: &[u8], creator_did: &str, creator_key: &[u8; 32], assertion: Assertion) -> Result<ProvenanceClaim>
  Sign a provenance claim over the media content hash + metadata.

- verify_provenance(claim: &ProvenanceClaim, creator_public: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<bool>
  Verify the signature and check integrity hash matches.

- attach_provenance(attachment: &mut serde_json::Value, claim: &ProvenanceClaim)
  Add provenance field to an AP media attachment object.

- extract_provenance(attachment: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<ProvenanceClaim>
  Extract provenance from received attachment if present.

- Assertion enum: Original, Repost, Edited, AiGenerated, Unknown

Verification chain:
1. Extract provenance from attachment
2. Download media, compute SHA-256
3. Verify integrity hash matches (content hasn't been modified)
4. Resolve creator DID to public key
5. Verify Ed25519 signature over canonical claim
6. If all pass: display provenance badge

Journalism use case:
- News organization posts photo with provenance: 'Original, by did:key of photojournalist'
- Photo gets reshared across fediverse
- Any aware server can verify: this specific image was posted by this specific person at this specific time and has not been modified
- Doesn't prove the photo wasn't deepfaked, but proves the chain of custody from poster to viewer

AI content labeling:
- AI-generated images can be tagged with assertion: 'ai-generated'
- The DID signature proves WHO made the AI claim (the poster, not a third party)
- Complements EU AI Act and similar regulations requiring AI content disclosure

Deps: ed25519-dalek, sha2, base64, fedi-did, serde, serde_json.

Builds on: fedi-integrity (for signing), content-addressed media (for integrity hashes). These three form a stack: integrity hashes -> signed objects -> provenance claims.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"mark@wolfssl.com","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:54:58.557072635Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-07-20T02:54:58.557072635Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"fedistract-rr9g.5","depends_on_id":"fedistract-rr9g","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:54:58.567478929Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"fedistract-rr9g.5","depends_on_id":"fedistract-rr9g.1","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:55:21.009085176Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"fedistract-rr9g.5","depends_on_id":"fedistract-rr9g.2","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:55:21.051260094Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
